name: Greenland
facts: Autonomous territory within the Kingdom of Denmark

flag.description: Two equal horizontal bands of white over red, with a disc set towards the hoist whose colours are reversed: red in the white half and white in the red half.
flag.symbolism: The white band is the ice sheet and the red band the ocean; the red half-disc is the sun sinking into the sea, and the white half-disc is icebergs and pack ice.

hook: Greenland is a midnight sun half-sunk in the sea: a white-over-red flag like Poland's, but with a two-tone disc sitting near the pole.
trivia: It is the only flag in the Nordic countries and their territories without a Nordic cross.
Designed by Thue Christiansen, it is called Erfalasorput, "our flag", in Greenlandic.
